Blog Test If you are seeing this, your blog is working correctly.
Purpose of This Post This post exists to validate multiple aspects of your blog setup. The main goal is to ensure that the Table of Contents (ToC) is working properly, that headings are being detected correctly, and that navigation between sections is smooth.
In addition, this post helps verify visual consistency, spacing, and general readability of long-form content.
Section 1 - Basic Validation What is being tested? We are checking whether the blog:
Displays headings correctly Generates the Table of Contents automatically Keeps content structure consistent Expected behavior You should see a Table of Contents with links pointing to each section of this post. Clicking on those links should scroll the page to the corresponding section.
Section 2 - Content Structure Organization matters Even though Hugo uses front matter for ordering, having a clear folder structure helps maintain organization and readability in your project.
Practical approach Use a structure that makes sense for you, such as organizing posts by year and month. This does not affect rendering but improves maintainability.
Section 3 - Theme Behavior Table of Contents The Table of Contents is generated based on headings. The deeper the hierarchy, the more detailed the ToC becomes.
What to observe Are all headings listed? Is the indentation correct? Does navigation feel natural? Section 4 - Long Content Test This section exists mainly to increase the length of the article. A longer post helps validate scrolling behavior, spacing, and overall layout consistency.
Writing longer content also simulates real-world usage, where posts are rarely short and often include multiple sections and ideas.
Section 5 - Nested Headings Level 3 Level 4 Level 5 Level 6 This hierarchy ensures that deeper heading levels are correctly interpreted and displayed.
Section 6 - Lists Ordered list First item Second item Third item Unordered list Item A Item B Item C Section 7 - Final Validation At this point, you should confirm:
The Table of Contents is visible All sections are clickable Navigation works as expected Layout remains consistent throughout the page Conclusion If everything looks correct, your blog setup is working as intended. You are ready to start writing real content.
